caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular, brownish-orange paperweight with a sculpted figure of a reclining dog with long ears and a raised head on top. The paperweight sits on a stack of two off-white sheets of paper with visible folds or layers, which are positioned on a flat wooden surface. The background is a plain, light beige color. Above the depicted objects, the words "PAPER WEIGHT" are written in large, capitalized letters, with "CIRCA 1849" written below in smaller, spaced-out letters. The overall color composition features tones of brown, orange, beige, and white.
title: Spaniel (Paper Weight)
